about.title: Your comfort is our priority.
text: Arnett Mechanical is a family-owned and operated HVAC company based in Rosharon, Texas. We are dedicated to providing our neighbors with reliable, efficient and affordable heating and cooling solutions. With years of experience serving the greater Houston area, we have built a reputation for quality workmanship, exceptional customer service and a commitment to exceeding expectations.

Our team of skilled technicians is equipped to handle all your HVAC needs, from routine maintenance and repairs to new system installations. We understand that a comfortable indoor environment is essential for your home or business, and we strive to deliver solutions that meet your specific requirements and budget.

Arnett Mechanical LLC is a minority-owned company founded in 2017. We are a small business providing HVAC services to commercial, multi-family, industrial and residential properties, and we are HUB, MBE and SBE certified.

faqs.q: When is it time to replace my air conditioner rather than repair it?
faqs.a: If your AC is over 10 to 15 years old it may be nearing the end of its useful life, and older units are less efficient and more prone to breakdowns. Frequent repairs, rising energy bills on the same usage habits, uneven cooling between rooms and strange noises such as grinding, rattling or squealing are the other signs.

faqs.q: Do you answer calls outside business hours?
faqs.a: Yes. We are open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday, and we offer 24/7 emergency AC repair in Sienna, Rosharon, Pearland, Missouri City and the surrounding areas. Call any time, day or night.

faqs.q: How will I know the price before work starts?
faqs.a: We believe in upfront and honest pricing, with no hidden fees or surprises. We provide you with a detailed estimate before any work begins, so you know exactly what to expect.

faqs.q: What does a maintenance visit include?
faqs.a: A thorough cleaning of the coils, filters and other components, a comprehensive inspection covering electrical connections, refrigerant levels and ductwork, a performance tune-up, and preventative maintenance to help avoid breakdowns.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide design, installation, replacement, repair and maintenance for commercial, multi-family and industrial properties, including rooftop package units, reach-in coolers and freezers, and mini splits.
